name: glb-designer-mobile-audit
description: AUDIT (not a regression leg) — drive the GLB designer on a 390x844 phone viewport with SHOT_TOUCH to capture the mobile UX defects: overlay-cluster collisions, touch-target sizes, viewport split, ProfileEditor, disclosures.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: seed-crowded
steps.comment: Multiple parts + a group so the layers tree + overlays are exercised; then select one part to force ALL viewport overlays (gizmo mode, pivot, snap, view presets, env, dims).
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); s.parts = [ { id:'top', kind:'box', name:'Top', position:[0,0.72,0], size:[1.2,0.04,0.7], color:'#8a5a3c', roughness:0.5, metalness:0.1 }, { id:'leg1', kind:'cylinder', name:'Leg 1', position:[-0.5,0.36,-0.28], size:[0.06,0.72,0.06], color:'#4a4a4a' }, { id:'leg2', kind:'cylinder', name:'Leg 2', position:[0.5,0.36,-0.28], size:[0.06,0.72,0.06], color:'#4a4a4a' }, { id:'leg3', kind:'cylinder', name:'Leg 3', position:[-0.5,0.36,0.28], size:[0.06,0.72,0.06], color:'#4a4a4a' }, { id:'leg4', kind:'cylinder', name:'Leg 4', position:[0.5,0.36,0.28], size:[0.06,0.72,0.06], color:'#4a4a4a' } ]; s.partGroups = [{ id:'legs-g', name:'Legs', partIds:['leg1','leg2','leg3','leg4'] }]; window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); })()

steps.name: select-top-part
steps.comment: Tap the 'Top' layer row to select a single part → part gizmo + pivot + all overlays.
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')]; const t=rows.find(r=>/Top/.test(r.textContent)); if(!t) throw new Error('Top row not found'); t.click(); })()

steps.name: select-group
steps.comment: Select the Legs group to show the group gizmo overlays.
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')]; const g=rows.find(r=>/Legs/.test(r.textContent)); if(!g) throw new Error('Legs row not found'); g.click(); })()

steps.name: add-lathe
steps.comment: Add a lathe shape to surface the ProfileEditor in the inspector.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); s.parts.push({ id:'vase', kind:'lathe', name:'Vase', position:[0,0.2,0], size:[0.3,0.4,0.3], color:'#c0a060', profile:[[0.2,0],[0.4,0.3],[0.25,0.6],[0.3,1]], segments:24 }); window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); })()

steps.name: select-vase
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')]; const v=rows.find(r=>/Vase/.test(r.textContent)); if(!v) throw new Error('Vase row not found'); v.click(); })()

steps.name: scroll-to-profile
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg=document.querySelector('.glb-designer svg[aria-label="Profile point editor"]'); if(svg) svg.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
